name: bartaco
disclaimer_extra: bartaco publishes nutrition per menu item: each taco is one taco (bartaco suggests 3 to 5 per person), and every other row is one order as served. Figures are bartaco's own, from the nutrition database behind bartaco.com/nutrition, which covers the in-store menu including cocktails and happy hour. Rows marked may not be at every location are in that database but on no menu we could check, so your bartaco may not serve them. Not listed, because bartaco prints calories but publishes no full nutrition for them: sodas, sparkling waters, iced teas, limeade, beer and wine, the chicken + black bean bowl, taco and family packs, kids trays, the large guac + verde + roja and a gelato cone.
blurb: Count your bartaco tacos, add guac, sides and a rice bowl, and watch calories, protein, carbs and fat add up for the whole table — every taco on the menu, with bartaco's own figures.

consistency.no_presets: bartaco publishes every taco, bowl and plate as a finished menu item and offers no build-your-own, so each row already IS a menu item; a meal is several of them, which the plain list expresses directly.
